WITH max_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(dc.date) AS max_dt
    FROM rgm.gold.fact_trade_promotions ftp
    JOIN rgm.gold.dim_calendar dc ON ftp.date_id = dc.date_id
  )
  SELECT
    dc.year_num,
    dc.month_num,
    dc.month_name AS period,
    CASE
      WHEN SUM(ftp.promo_spends) >= 1000000 THEN CONCAT(CAST(ROUND(SUM(ftp.promo_spends)/1000000,1) AS STRING), 'M')
      WHEN SUM(ftp.promo_spends) >= 1000    THEN CONCAT(CAST(ROUND(SUM(ftp.promo_spends)/1000,0)   AS STRING), 'K')
      ELSE CAST(ROUND(SUM(ftp.promo_spends),0) AS STRING)
    END AS actual_spend,
    CASE
      WHEN SUM(ftp.base_sales * 0.9) >= 1000000 THEN CONCAT(CAST(ROUND(SUM(ftp.base_sales*0.9)/1000000,1) AS STRING), 'M')
      WHEN SUM(ftp.base_sales * 0.9) >= 1000    THEN CONCAT(CAST(ROUND(SUM(ftp.base_sales*0.9)/1000,0)   AS STRING), 'K')
      ELSE CAST(ROUND(SUM(ftp.base_sales*0.9),0) AS STRING)
    END AS planned_spend
  FROM rgm.gold.fact_trade_promotions ftp
  JOIN rgm.gold.dim_calendar dc ON ftp.date_id = dc.date_id
  CROSS JOIN max_date md
  WHERE YEAR(dc.date) = YEAR(md.max_dt)
    AND MONTH(dc.date) = MONTH(md.max_dt)
  GROUP BY dc.year_num, dc.month_num, dc.month_name
  ORDER BY dc.year_num, dc.month_num

SELECT MAX(date_of_data) AS latest_date, COUNT(*) AS account_rows, ROUND(SUM(total_equity),2) AS total_equity
  FROM wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.account_summary

WITH ranked_trades AS (

    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY trade_id
            ORDER BY
                CASE workflow_status
                    WHEN 'Reconciled' THEN 2
                    WHEN 'Confirmed' THEN 1
                    ELSE 0
                END DESC,
                load_time DESC
        ) AS rn

    FROM wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.silver.transaction_blotter

    WHERE workflow_status IN ('Confirmed', 'Reconciled')
      AND broker_month >= add_months(current_date(), -24)

)

SELECT

    DATE(date_trunc('quarter', broker_month)) AS quarter,

    SUM(gross_comm) AS total_revenue,

    ROUND(
        (SUM(gross_comm) / NULLIF(SUM(investment_amount), 0)) * 10000,
        2
    ) AS fee_rate_bps

FROM ranked_trades

WHERE rn = 1

GROUP BY
    DATE(date_trunc('quarter', broker_month))

ORDER BY
    quarter;

SELECT SUM(p.amount) AS total_aum
FROM wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.positions p
JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.financial_account a
    ON p.financial_account_id = a.financial_account_id
WHERE p.snapshot_date = (
    SELECT MAX(snapshot_date)
    FROM wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.positions
)
  AND a.account_status_indicator = 'O'
  AND a.is_active = 1

WITH latest_snapshot AS (
    SELECT
        MAX(snapshot_date) AS end_date
    FROM wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.positions
),

beginning_snapshot AS (

    SELECT
        MAX(snapshot_date) AS start_date
    FROM wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.positions
    WHERE snapshot_date < (
        SELECT DATE_TRUNC('year', end_date)
        FROM latest_snapshot
    )

),

beginning_aum AS (

    SELECT
        SUM(p.amount) AS beginning_aum

    FROM wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.positions p

    JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.financial_account fa
        ON p.financial_account_id = fa.financial_account_id

    WHERE p.snapshot_date = (
            SELECT snapshot_date
            FROM beginning_snapshot
          )
      AND fa.account_status_indicator = 'O'
      AND fa.is_active = 1

),

net_new_assets AS (

    SELECT

        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN t.transaction_code IN
                    ('CONTRIBUTION','TRANSFER_IN','RFF','CSR')
                THEN ABS(t.amount)
                ELSE 0
            END
        )
        -
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN t.transaction_code IN
                    ('DISTRIBUTION','TRANSFER_OUT','SFF','PCC')
                THEN ABS(t.amount)
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS nna

    FROM wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.transactions t

    JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.financial_account fa
        ON t.financial_account_id = fa.financial_account_id

    CROSS JOIN latest_snapshot ls
    CROSS JOIN beginning_snapshot bs

    WHERE CAST(t.transaction_date AS DATE)
          BETWEEN bs.start_date
              AND ls.end_date

      AND fa.account_status_indicator = 'O'
      AND fa.is_active = 1

)

SELECT

    ROUND(nna.nna,2) AS net_new_assets,

    ROUND(ba.beginning_aum,2) AS beginning_aum,

    ROUND(
        (
            nna.nna /
            NULLIF(ba.beginning_aum,0)
        )
        *
        (12.0 / MONTH(ls.end_date))
        * 100,
        2
    ) AS organic_growth_rate

FROM net_new_assets nna

CROSS JOIN beginning_aum ba
CROSS JOIN latest_snapshot ls;

WITH latest_snapshot AS (

    SELECT
        MAX(snapshot_date) AS end_date
    FROM wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.positions

),

beginning_snapshot AS (

    SELECT
        MAX(snapshot_date) AS start_date
    FROM wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.positions
    WHERE snapshot_date < (
        SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter', end_date)
        FROM latest_snapshot
    )

),

beginning_aum AS (

    SELECT

        SUM(p.amount) AS beginning_aum

    FROM wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.positions p

    JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.financial_account fa
        ON p.financial_account_id = fa.financial_account_id

    CROSS JOIN beginning_snapshot bs

    WHERE p.snapshot_date = bs.start_date
      AND fa.account_status_indicator = 'O'
      AND fa.is_active = 1

),

outflows AS (

    SELECT

        SUM(ABS(t.amount)) AS outflow_amount

    FROM wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.transactions t

    JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.financial_account fa
        ON t.financial_account_id = fa.financial_account_id

    CROSS JOIN latest_snapshot ls
    CROSS JOIN beginning_snapshot bs

    WHERE CAST(t.transaction_date AS DATE)
          BETWEEN bs.start_date
              AND ls.end_date

      AND t.transaction_code IN
            (
                'DISTRIBUTION',
                'TRANSFER_OUT',
                'SFF',
                'PCC'
            )
      AND fa.account_status_indicator = 'O'
      AND fa.is_active = 1

)

SELECT

    ROUND(ba.beginning_aum,2) AS beginning_aum,

    ROUND(COALESCE(o.outflow_amount,0),2) AS outflows,

    ROUND(

        (
            ba.beginning_aum
            -
            COALESCE(o.outflow_amount,0)
        )
        /
        NULLIF(ba.beginning_aum,0)
        * 100,

        2

    ) AS client_retention_rate

FROM beginning_aum ba

CROSS JOIN outflows o;

SELECT
    MAKE_DATE(YEAR(snapshot_date), MONTH(snapshot_date), 1) AS month,
    SUM(amount) AS total_monthly_aum
FROM wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.positions
WHERE snapshot_date >= ADD_MONTHS(
    MAKE_DATE(YEAR(current_date()), MONTH(current_date()), 1),
    -23
)
GROUP BY MAKE_DATE(YEAR(snapshot_date), MONTH(snapshot_date), 1)
ORDER BY month

WITH latest_snapshot AS (

    SELECT
        MAX(snapshot_date) AS snapshot_date
    FROM wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.positions

),

current_allocation AS (

    SELECT
        s.asset_class,
        SUM(ABS(p.amount)) AS market_value

    FROM wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.positions p

    INNER JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.securities s
        ON p.cusip = s.cusip
       AND s.is_active = 1
    JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.financial_account f
        ON f.financial_account_id = p.financial_account_id
        AND f.is_active = 1
        AND f.account_status_indicator = 'O'

    CROSS JOIN latest_snapshot ls

    WHERE p.snapshot_date = ls.snapshot_date

    GROUP BY
        s.asset_class

),

total_mv AS (

    SELECT
        SUM(market_value) AS total_market_value
    FROM current_allocation

),

model_target AS (

    SELECT

        SUM(d.target_equity_pct * d.total_aum_in_model)
            / NULLIF(SUM(d.total_aum_in_model),0) AS target_equity_pct,

        SUM(d.target_fi_pct * d.total_aum_in_model)
            / NULLIF(SUM(d.total_aum_in_model),0) AS target_fi_pct,

        SUM(d.target_alt_pct * d.total_aum_in_model)
            / NULLIF(SUM(d.total_aum_in_model),0) AS target_alt_pct,

        SUM(d.target_cash_pct * d.total_aum_in_model)
            / NULLIF(SUM(d.total_aum_in_model),0) AS target_cash_pct

    FROM wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.silver.account_model_mapping amm

    INNER JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.dim_model_portfolio d
        ON amm.model_id = d.model_id

)

SELECT

    ca.asset_class,

    ROUND(
        (ca.market_value / tm.total_market_value) * 100,
        2
    ) AS current_pct,

    CASE

        WHEN ca.asset_class = 'Equity'
            THEN mt.target_equity_pct

        WHEN ca.asset_class = 'Fixed Income'
            THEN mt.target_fi_pct

        WHEN ca.asset_class = 'Alternative Investments'
            THEN mt.target_alt_pct

        WHEN ca.asset_class = 'Cash & Cash Equivalent'
            THEN mt.target_cash_pct

        ELSE 0

    END AS target_pct

FROM current_allocation ca

CROSS JOIN total_mv tm

CROSS JOIN model_target mt

ORDER BY
    current_pct DESC;

SELECT
    SUM(p.amount) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT a.investment_professional_number), 0) AS aum_per_advisor
FROM wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.positions p
JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.financial_account a
    ON p.financial_account_id = a.financial_account_id
WHERE p.snapshot_date = (
    SELECT MAX(snapshot_date)
    FROM wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.positions
)
  AND a.account_status_indicator = 'O'
  AND a.is_active = 1

WITH latest_snapshot AS (

    SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) AS end_date
    FROM wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.positions

),

beginning_snapshot AS (

    SELECT
        MAX(snapshot_date) AS start_date
    FROM wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.positions
    WHERE snapshot_date <
        (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('year', end_date)
         FROM latest_snapshot)

),

departed_households AS (

    SELECT *
    FROM (

        SELECT

            hd.house_hold_name,

            fa.investment_professional_number,

            MAX(fa.date_account_closed) AS close_date,

            COUNT(
                CASE
                    WHEN fa.account_status_indicator <> 'C'
                    THEN 1
                END
            ) AS open_accounts

        FROM wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.household_details hd

        JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.financial_account fa
            ON hd.financial_account_id = fa.financial_account_id

        WHERE fa.is_active = 1

        GROUP BY

            hd.house_hold_name,
            fa.investment_professional_number

    ) x

    CROSS JOIN latest_snapshot ls
    CROSS JOIN beginning_snapshot bs

    WHERE open_accounts = 0
      AND close_date BETWEEN bs.start_date
                         AND ls.end_date

),

last_snapshot AS (

    SELECT

        dh.house_hold_name,

        MAX(p.snapshot_date) AS snapshot_date

    FROM departed_households dh

    JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.household_details hd
        ON dh.house_hold_name = hd.house_hold_name

    JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.positions p
        ON hd.financial_account_id = p.financial_account_id

    WHERE p.snapshot_date < CAST(dh.close_date AS DATE)

    GROUP BY dh.house_hold_name

),

household_aum AS (

    SELECT

        dh.investment_professional_number,

        dh.house_hold_name,

        SUM(p.amount) AS aum_lost

    FROM departed_households dh

    JOIN last_snapshot ls
        ON dh.house_hold_name = ls.house_hold_name

    JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.household_details hd
        ON dh.house_hold_name = hd.house_hold_name

    JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.positions p
        ON hd.financial_account_id = p.financial_account_id
       AND p.snapshot_date = ls.snapshot_date

    GROUP BY

        dh.investment_professional_number,
        dh.house_hold_name

)

SELECT

    investment_professional_number AS advisor,

    COUNT(*) AS hh_departed,

    ROUND(SUM(aum_lost),2) AS aum_lost

FROM household_aum

GROUP BY investment_professional_number

ORDER BY aum_lost DESC;

WITH snapshot_refs AS (

    SELECT

        (
            SELECT MAX(snapshot_date)
            FROM wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.positions
        ) AS current_snapshot,

        (
            SELECT MAX(snapshot_date)
            FROM wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.positions
            WHERE snapshot_date <= ADD_MONTHS(
                (
                    SELECT MAX(snapshot_date)
                    FROM wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.positions
                ),
                -12
            )
        ) AS prior_snapshot

),

current_aum AS (

    SELECT

        fa.investment_professional_number,

        SUM(p.amount) AS current_aum

    FROM wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.positions p

    JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.financial_account fa
        ON p.financial_account_id = fa.financial_account_id

    CROSS JOIN snapshot_refs s

    WHERE p.snapshot_date = s.current_snapshot
      AND fa.account_status_indicator = 'O'
      AND fa.is_active = 1

    GROUP BY
        fa.investment_professional_number

),

prior_aum AS (

    SELECT

        fa.investment_professional_number,

        SUM(p.amount) AS prior_aum

    FROM wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.positions p

    JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.financial_account fa
        ON p.financial_account_id = fa.financial_account_id

    CROSS JOIN snapshot_refs s

    WHERE p.snapshot_date = s.prior_snapshot
      AND fa.account_status_indicator = 'O'
      AND fa.is_active = 1

    GROUP BY
        fa.investment_professional_number

),

advisor_growth AS (

    SELECT

        c.investment_professional_number,

        c.current_aum,

        COALESCE(p.prior_aum,0) AS prior_aum,

        ROUND(
            (
                (c.current_aum - p.prior_aum)
                /
                NULLIF(p.prior_aum,0)
            ) * 100,
            2
        ) AS growth_pct

    FROM current_aum c

    LEFT JOIN prior_aum p
        ON c.investment_professional_number = p.investment_professional_number

)

SELECT

    fa.rep_id AS advisor_id,

    fa.record_assigned_name AS advisor_name,

    ROUND(ag.current_aum,2) AS current_aum,

    ag.growth_pct

FROM advisor_growth ag

JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.financial_advisor fa
    ON ag.investment_professional_number = fa.rep_id

ORDER BY
    growth_pct DESC,
    current_aum DESC

LIMIT 1;

WITH latest_snapshot AS (

    SELECT
        MAX(snapshot_date) AS end_date
    FROM wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.positions

),

date_filter AS (

    SELECT
        end_date,
        DATE_TRUNC('year', end_date) AS start_date
    FROM latest_snapshot

),

advisor_nnm AS (

    SELECT
        fa.investment_professional_number,

        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN t.transaction_code IN ('CONTRIBUTION','TRANSFER_IN','RFF','CSR')
                THEN ABS(t.amount)
                ELSE 0
            END
        )
        -
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN t.transaction_code IN ('DISTRIBUTION','TRANSFER_OUT','SFF','PCC')
                THEN ABS(t.amount)
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS net_new_money

    FROM wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.transactions t

    INNER JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.financial_account fa
        ON t.financial_account_id = fa.financial_account_id

    WHERE CAST(t.transaction_date AS DATE)
          BETWEEN (SELECT start_date FROM date_filter)
              AND (SELECT end_date FROM date_filter)
      AND fa.account_status_indicator = 'O'
      AND fa.is_active = 1

    GROUP BY fa.investment_professional_number

),

advisor_aum AS (

    SELECT
        p.investment_professional_number,
        SUM(p.amount) AS current_aum

    FROM wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.positions p

    WHERE p.snapshot_date = (
        SELECT end_date
        FROM latest_snapshot
    )

    GROUP BY p.investment_professional_number

)

SELECT

    fa.rep_id as investment_professional_number,
    fa.record_assigned_name as advisor_name,

    ROUND(n.net_new_money,2) AS net_new_money,

    ROUND(a.current_aum,2) AS current_aum,

    ROUND(
        CASE
            WHEN a.current_aum > 0
            THEN (n.net_new_money / a.current_aum) * 100
            ELSE 0
        END,
        2
    ) AS net_new_money_pct

FROM advisor_nnm n

JOIN advisor_aum a
    ON n.investment_professional_number = a.investment_professional_number

JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.financial_advisor fa
    ON n.investment_professional_number = fa.rep_id

ORDER BY net_new_money_pct DESC, current_aum DESC

LIMIT 1;

WITH client_segment AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        pfm.financial_account_id,
        CASE
            WHEN pa.entity_name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(pa.entity_name) <> '' THEN 'Corporate'
            WHEN pa.maximum_net_worth >= 1000000 THEN 'HNW'
            WHEN pa.maximum_net_worth >= 10000000 THEN 'UHNW'
            WHEN pa.maximum_net_worth IS NOT NULL THEN 'Mass Affluent'
            WHEN pa.maximum_annual_income >= 1000000 THEN 'UHNW (Estimated)'
            WHEN pa.maximum_annual_income >= 250000 THEN 'HNW (Estimated)'
            ELSE 'Mass Affluent'
        END AS client_segment
    FROM wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.person_financial_mapping pfm
    JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.person_account pa
        ON pfm.person_account_id = pa.person_account_id
)

SELECT
    cs.client_segment,
    ROUND(SUM(p.amount), 2) AS total_aum
FROM wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.positions p
INNER JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.financial_account fa
    ON p.financial_account_id = fa.financial_account_id
   AND fa.is_active = 1
LEFT JOIN client_segment cs
    ON p.financial_account_id = cs.financial_account_id

WHERE p.snapshot_date = (
    SELECT
        MAX(snapshot_date) AS snapshot_date
    FROM wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.positions
)
AND fa.account_status_indicator = 'O'
GROUP BY cs.client_segment

WITH latest_snapshot AS (
    SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) AS max_snapshot_date
    FROM wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.positions
),

monthly_last_snapshot AS (
    SELECT
        DATE(date_trunc('month', p.snapshot_date)) AS month,
        MAX(p.snapshot_date) AS last_snapshot_date

    FROM wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.positions p
    CROSS JOIN latest_snapshot l

    WHERE p.snapshot_date >= add_months(
        DATE(date_trunc('month', l.max_snapshot_date)),
        -11
    )

    GROUP BY DATE(date_trunc('month', p.snapshot_date))
)

SELECT
    m.month,
    fp.investment_professional_number,
    SUM(ABS(fp.amount)) AS aum

FROM monthly_last_snapshot m
JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.positions fp
    ON fp.snapshot_date = m.last_snapshot_date
JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.financial_account f
    ON fp.financial_account_id = f.financial_account_id
WHERE f.account_status_indicator = 'O'
       AND f.is_active = 1
GROUP BY
    m.month,
    fp.investment_professional_number

ORDER BY
    fp.investment_professional_number,
    m.month,
    aum DESC;

WITH latest_snapshot AS (
    SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) AS end_date
    FROM wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.positions
),
prior_snapshot AS (
    SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) AS end_date
    FROM wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.positions
    WHERE snapshot_date <= ADD_MONTHS(
        (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.positions),
        -12
    )
),
current_aum AS (
    SELECT
        a.investment_professional_number,
        SUM(p.amount) AS aum
    FROM wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.positions p
    JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.financial_account a
        ON p.financial_account_id = a.financial_account_id
    CROSS JOIN latest_snapshot ls
    WHERE p.snapshot_date = ls.end_date
      AND a.account_status_indicator = 'O'
      AND a.is_active = 1
    GROUP BY a.investment_professional_number
),
prior_aum AS (
    SELECT
        a.investment_professional_number,
        SUM(p.amount) AS aum
    FROM wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.positions p
    JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.financial_account a
        ON p.financial_account_id = a.financial_account_id
    CROSS JOIN prior_snapshot ps
    WHERE p.snapshot_date = ps.end_date
      AND a.account_status_indicator = 'O'
      AND a.is_active = 1
    GROUP BY a.investment_professional_number
)
SELECT
    c.investment_professional_number,
    ROUND(
        (c.aum - COALESCE(pr.aum, 0)) / NULLIF(pr.aum, 0) * 100,
        2
    ) AS growth_rate
FROM current_aum c
LEFT JOIN prior_aum pr
    ON c.investment_professional_number = pr.investment_professional_number

WITH latest_snapshot AS (

    SELECT
        MAX(snapshot_date) AS snapshot_date
    FROM wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.positions

),

client_segment AS (

    SELECT
        t.house_hold_name,

        CASE
            WHEN MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN t.entity_name IS NOT NULL
                         AND TRIM(t.entity_name) <> ''
                    THEN 1
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ) = 1
                THEN 'Corporate'

            WHEN SUM(t.maximum_net_worth) >= 10000000
                THEN 'UHNW'

            WHEN SUM(t.maximum_net_worth) >= 1000000
                THEN 'HNW'

            WHEN SUM(t.maximum_net_worth) IS NOT NULL
                THEN 'Mass Affluent'

            WHEN SUM(t.maximum_annual_income) >= 1000000
                THEN 'UHNW (Estimated)'

            WHEN SUM(t.maximum_annual_income) >= 250000
                THEN 'HNW (Estimated)'

            ELSE 'Mass Affluent'
        END AS client_segment

    FROM (

        SELECT DISTINCT

            hd.house_hold_name,
            pa.person_account_id,
            pa.entity_name,
            pa.maximum_net_worth,
            pa.maximum_annual_income

        FROM wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.positions p

        JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.household_details hd
            ON p.financial_account_id = hd.financial_account_id

        JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.person_financial_mapping pfm
            ON p.financial_account_id = pfm.financial_account_id

        JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.person_account pa
            ON pfm.person_account_id = pa.person_account_id

        JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.financial_account fa
            ON p.financial_account_id = fa.financial_account_id

        WHERE p.snapshot_date = (
                SELECT snapshot_date
                FROM latest_snapshot
              )
          AND fa.account_status_indicator = 'O'
          AND fa.is_active = 1

    ) t

    GROUP BY
        t.house_hold_name

),

household_aum AS (

    SELECT

        hd.house_hold_name,

        SUM(p.amount) AS household_aum

    FROM wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.positions p

    JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.household_details hd
        ON p.financial_account_id = hd.financial_account_id

WITH latest_snapshot AS (
    SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) AS max_snapshot_date
    FROM wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.positions
),

/* Organic Growth Rate - Beginning AUM */
beg AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(p.amount) AS beg_aum
    FROM wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.positions p
    JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.financial_account a
        ON p.financial_account_id = a.financial_account_id
    CROSS JOIN latest_snapshot l
    WHERE p.snapshot_date = (
        SELECT MAX(snapshot_date)
        FROM wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.positions
        WHERE snapshot_date < DATE_TRUNC(
            'year',
            l.max_snapshot_date
        )
    )
    AND a.account_status_indicator = 'O'
    AND a.is_active = 1
),


/* Organic Growth Rate - NNA YTD */
nna AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(
            CASE 
                WHEN t.transaction_code IN 
                    ('CONTRIBUTION','TRANSFER_IN','RFF','CSR')
                THEN ABS(t.amount)
                ELSE 0
            END
        )
        -
        SUM(
            CASE 
                WHEN t.transaction_code IN 
                    ('DISTRIBUTION','TRANSFER_OUT','SFF','PCC')
                THEN ABS(t.amount)
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS nna

    FROM wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.transactions t

    CROSS JOIN latest_snapshot l

    WHERE CAST(t.transaction_date AS DATE)
          BETWEEN DATE_TRUNC('year', l.max_snapshot_date)
          AND l.max_snapshot_date
),


elapsed_months AS (
    SELECT
        MONTH(max_snapshot_date) AS months_elapsed
    FROM latest_snapshot
),


organic_growth AS (
    SELECT
        (
            nna.nna
            /
            NULLIF(beg.beg_aum,0)
        )
        *
        (
            12.0
            /
            elapsed_months.months_elapsed
        )
        *
        100 AS organic_growth_rate

    FROM beg
    CROSS JOIN nna
    CROSS JOIN elapsed_months
),


/* Ring 2 - % Advisors with Positive NNA */
advisor_nna AS (
    SELECT
        a.investment_professional_number,

        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN t.transaction_code IN 
                    ('CONTRIBUTION','TRANSFER_IN','RFF','CSR')
                THEN ABS(t.amount)
                ELSE 0
            END
        )
        -
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN t.transaction_code IN 
                    ('DISTRIBUTION','TRANSFER_OUT','SFF','PCC')
                THEN ABS(t.amount)
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS advisor_nna
    FROM wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.transactions t
    JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.financial_account a
        ON t.financial_account_id = a.financial_account_id
    CROSS JOIN latest_snapshot l
    WHERE CAST(t.transaction_date AS DATE)
          BETWEEN DATE_TRUNC('year', l.max_snapshot_date)
          AND l.max_snapshot_date
    GROUP BY
        a.investment_professional_number
),
positive_nna_advisors AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(
            CASE WHEN advisor_nna > 0 THEN 1 END
        )
        * 100.0
        /
        NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS pct_advisors_positive
    FROM advisor_nna
),


/* Ring 3 - Revenue Run Rate */
revenue_run_rate AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(fc.gross_comm) * 4.0 AS annualized_revenue
    FROM wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.fa_commission fc
    CROSS JOIN latest_snapshot l
    WHERE fc.broker_month >= DATE_TRUNC(
            'quarter',
            l.max_snapshot_date
          )
      AND fc.broker_month <= l.max_snapshot_date
),

/* Ring 4 - Client Retention */
client_retention AS (
    SELECT
        f.investment_professional_number,
        COUNT(DISTINCT h.house_hold_name) AS household_count,
        COUNT(
            DISTINCT CASE
                WHEN f.account_status_indicator = 'O'
                THEN f.financial_account_id
            END
        ) * 100.0
        /
        NULLIF(
            COUNT(DISTINCT f.financial_account_id),

        ) AS retention_pct
    FROM wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.household_details h
    JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.financial_account f
        ON f.financial_account_id = h.financial_account_id
    WHERE f.is_active = 1
    GROUP BY
        f.investment_professional_number
)
SELECT
    og.organic_growth_rate,
    p.pct_advisors_positive,
    r.annualized_revenue,
    c.retention_pct
FROM organic_growth og
CROSS JOIN positive_nna_advisors p
CROSS JOIN revenue_run_rate r
CROSS JOIN client_retention c;

WITH latest_snapshot AS (

current_year_revenue AS (

    CROSS JOIN latest_snapshot lm

          DATE_TRUNC('year', lm.latest_date)

      AND fa.account_status_indicator='O'
      AND fa.is_active=1
),

previous_year_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(fc.gross_comm) AS ytd_revenue
    FROM wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.fa_commission fc
    JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.financial_account fa
        ON fc.financial_account_id = fa.financial_account_id
    CROSS JOIN current_year_revenue c
    CROSS JOIN latest_snapshot lm
    WHERE fc.broker_month BETWEEN
        ADD_MONTHS(
            DATE_TRUNC('year', lm.latest_date),
            -12
        )
        AND
        ADD_MONTHS(
            ADD_MONTHS(
                DATE_TRUNC('year', lm.latest_date),
                -12
            ),
            c.completed_months
        ) - 1
      AND fa.account_status_indicator='O'
      AND fa.is_active=1

)
SELECT

        2
    ) AS estimated_annual_revenue,

    ROUND(
        p.ytd_revenue * 12 / c.completed_months,
        2
    ) AS previous_estimated_revenue,

    ROUND(
        (
            (c.ytd_revenue * 12 / c.completed_months) - (p.ytd_revenue * 12 / c.completed_months)
        )/
        NULLIF((p.ytd_revenue * 12 / c.completed_months),0) * 100, 2
    ) AS yoy_growth_pct

FROM current_year_revenue c

CROSS JOIN previous_year_revenue p;

WITH latest_snapshot AS (
    SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) AS max_snapshot_date
    FROM wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.positions
),


/* Account level AUM and cash */
account_base AS (
    SELECT
        ac.financial_account_id,
        ac.account_number,
        ac.investment_professional_number,
        h.house_hold_name,
        (
            COALESCE(ac.trade_date_net_worth,0)
            +
            COALESCE(ac.cash_available,0)
        ) AS account_aum,
        CASE
            WHEN (
                COALESCE(ac.trade_date_net_worth,0)
                +
                COALESCE(ac.cash_available,0)
            ) = 0
            THEN 0
            ELSE
                ac.cash_available * 100.0
                /
                (
                    COALESCE(ac.trade_date_net_worth,0)
                    +
                    COALESCE(ac.cash_available,0)
                )
        END AS cash_pct
    FROM wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.account_summary ac
    JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.household_details h
        ON ac.financial_account_id = h.financial_account_id
),
/* Maximum security concentration per account */
account_concentration AS (
    SELECT
        p.financial_account_id,

        MAX(
            ABS(p.amount)
            *100.0
            /
            NULLIF(ab.account_aum,0)
        ) AS concentration_pct
    FROM wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.positions p
    JOIN account_base ab
        ON p.financial_account_id = ab.financial_account_id
    CROSS JOIN latest_snapshot l
    WHERE p.snapshot_date = l.max_snapshot_date
    GROUP BY
        p.financial_account_id
),
/* Account model drift */
account_drift AS (
    SELECT
        ab.financial_account_id,
        ABS(

            (
                ac.total_equity * 100.0
                /
                NULLIF(
                    (
                        COALESCE(ac.trade_date_net_worth,0)
                        +
                        COALESCE(ac.cash_available,0)
                    ),
                    0
                )

            )
            -
            dmp.target_equity_pct
        ) AS drift_pct
    FROM account_base ab
    JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.account_summary ac
        ON ab.financial_account_id =
           ac.financial_account_id
    JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.silver.account_model_mapping amm
        ON ab.account_number =
           amm.account_number
    JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.dim_model_portfolio dmp
        ON amm.model_id =
           dmp.model_id
),


/* Household weighted risk metrics */
household_risk AS (
    SELECT
        ab.investment_professional_number,
        ab.house_hold_name,
        /* Maximum concentration risk */
        MAX(
            COALESCE(cc.concentration_pct,0)
        ) AS concentration_risk,


        /* AUM weighted drift */
        SUM(
            COALESCE(ad.drift_pct,0)
            *
            ab.account_aum
        )
        /
        NULLIF(
            SUM(ab.account_aum),
            0
        ) AS drift_risk,


        /* AUM weighted cash */
        SUM(
            ab.cash_pct
            *
            ab.account_aum
        )
        /
        NULLIF(
            SUM(ab.account_aum),
            0
        ) AS cash_risk
    FROM account_base ab
    LEFT JOIN account_concentration cc
        ON ab.financial_account_id =
           cc.financial_account_id
    LEFT JOIN account_drift ad
        ON ab.financial_account_id =
           ad.financial_account_id
    GROUP BY
        ab.investment_professional_number,
        ab.house_hold_name
),
/* Calculate household risk score */
household_score AS (
    SELECT
        investment_professional_number,
        house_hold_name,
        (
            (CASE
                WHEN concentration_risk > 10
                THEN 100
                ELSE concentration_risk * 10
             END)

            +

            (CASE
                WHEN drift_risk > 8
                THEN 100
                ELSE drift_risk * 12.5
             END)

            +

            (CASE
                WHEN cash_risk > 10
                THEN 100
                ELSE cash_risk * 10
             END)

        ) / 3 AS risk_score
    FROM household_risk
)
SELECT
    investment_professional_number AS advisor,
    COUNT(
        CASE
            WHEN risk_score >= 70
            THEN 1
        END
    ) AS high_risk_households,
    COUNT(*) AS total_households,
    COUNT(
        CASE
            WHEN risk_score >= 70
            THEN 1
        END
    )
    *100.0
    /
    NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS high_risk_household_pct
FROM household_score
GROUP BY
    investment_professional_number;

WITH latest_snapshot AS (

household_aum AS (

household_nna_ytd AS (

          AND fa.is_active = 1
    GROUP BY

/* Current Equity % at Account Level */
account_equity AS (
    SELECT
        ac.account_number,
        ac.financial_account_id,
        ac.total_equity AS equity_value,

        (
            COALESCE(p.amount,0)
            +

        ) AS total_value,

        CASE
            WHEN (
                COALESCE(p.amount,0)
                +
                COALESCE(ac.cash_available,0)
            ) = 0
            THEN NULL

            ELSE ac.total_equity * 100.0
            /
            (
                COALESCE(p.amount,0)

            )

    FROM wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.positions p
    JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.account_summary ac
        ON p.financial_account_id = ac.financial_account_id
    JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.financial_account a

    CROSS JOIN latest_snapshot l

account_drift AS (

        ae.current_equity_pct,
        dmp.target_equity_pct,

    FROM account_equity ae
    JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.financial_account fa

    JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.household_details h

    JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.silver.account_model_mapping amm

    JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.dim_model_portfolio dmp

        AND fa.is_active = 1
),
/* Maximum security concentration per account */
account_concentration AS (
    SELECT
        p.financial_account_id,
        MAX(
            ABS(p.amount)
            *100.0
            /
            NULLIF(ab.account_aum,0)
        ) AS concentration_pct
    FROM wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.positions p
    JOIN account_base ab
        ON p.financial_account_id = ab.financial_account_id
    JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.financial_account fa
        ON p.financial_account_id = fa.financial_account_id
    CROSS JOIN latest_snapshot l
    WHERE p.snapshot_date = l.max_snapshot_date
          AND fa.account_status_indicator = 'O'
          AND fa.is_active = 1
    GROUP BY
        p.financial_account_id
),
/* Account model drift */
account_drift1 AS (
    SELECT
        ab.financial_account_id,
        ABS(

            (
                ac.total_equity * 100.0
                /
                NULLIF(
                    (
                        COALESCE(p.amount,0)
                        +
                        COALESCE(ac.cash_available,0)
                    ),
                    0
                )

            )
            -
            dmp.target_equity_pct
        ) AS drift_pct
    FROM wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.positions p
    JOIN account_base ab
        ON p.financial_account_id = ab.financial_account_id
    JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.account_summary ac
        ON ab.financial_account_id =
           ac.financial_account_id
    JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.silver.account_model_mapping amm
        ON ab.account_number =
           amm.account_number
    JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.dim_model_portfolio dmp
        ON amm.model_id =
           dmp.model_id
    CROSS JOIN latest_snapshot l
    WHERE p.snapshot_date = l.max_snapshot_date
),


/* Household weighted risk metrics */
household_risk AS (
    SELECT
        ab.house_hold_name,
        /* Maximum concentration risk */
        MAX(
            COALESCE(cc.concentration_pct,0)
        ) AS concentration_risk,


        /* AUM weighted drift */
        SUM(
            COALESCE(ad.drift_pct,0)
            *
            ab.account_aum
        )
        /
        NULLIF(
            SUM(ab.account_aum),
            0
        ) AS drift_risk,


        /* AUM weighted cash */
        SUM(
            ab.cash_pct
            *
            ab.account_aum
        )
        /
        NULLIF(
            SUM(ab.account_aum),
            0
        ) AS cash_risk
    FROM account_base ab
    LEFT JOIN account_concentration cc
        ON ab.financial_account_id =
           cc.financial_account_id
    LEFT JOIN account_drift1 ad
        ON ab.financial_account_id =
           ad.financial_account_id
    GROUP BY
        ab.house_hold_name
),
/* Calculate household risk score */
household_score AS (
    SELECT
        house_hold_name,
        (
            (CASE
                WHEN concentration_risk > 10
                THEN 100
                ELSE concentration_risk * 10
             END)

            +

            (CASE
                WHEN drift_risk > 8
                THEN 100
                ELSE drift_risk * 12.5
             END)

            +

            (CASE
                WHEN cash_risk > 10
                THEN 100
                ELSE cash_risk * 10
             END)

        ) / 3 AS risk_score
    FROM household_risk
),
household_alerts AS (

    SELECT

        hr.house_hold_name,

        CASE

            /* Critical */

            WHEN hr.concentration_risk > 10
                 OR hr.drift_risk > 8
            THEN CONCAT(
                    'CRITICAL - ',
                    CONCAT_WS(', ',
                        CASE
                            WHEN hr.concentration_risk > 10
                            THEN 'Concentration > 10%'
                        END,
                        CASE
                            WHEN hr.drift_risk > 8
                            THEN 'Model Drift > 8%'
                        END
                    )
                 )

            /* Warning */

            WHEN hr.drift_risk > 4
                 OR hr.cash_risk > 10
            THEN CONCAT(
                    'WARNING - ',
                    CONCAT_WS(', ',
                        CASE
                            WHEN hr.drift_risk > 4
                            THEN 'Model Drift > 4%'
                        END,
                        CASE
                            WHEN hr.cash_risk > 10
                            THEN 'Cash > 10%'
                        END
                    )
                 )

            /* Opportunity */

            WHEN ug.unrealized_gl < -5000
            THEN 'OPPORTUNITY - Tax Loss Harvesting'

            ELSE 'NO ALERT'

        END AS risk_alert,

        CASE

            WHEN hr.concentration_risk > 10
                 OR hr.drift_risk > 8
            THEN 'CRITICAL'

            WHEN hr.drift_risk > 4
                 OR hr.cash_risk > 10
            THEN 'WARNING'

            WHEN ug.unrealized_gl < -5000
            THEN 'OPPORTUNITY'

            ELSE 'NONE'

        END AS alert_severity

    FROM household_risk hr

    LEFT JOIN household_unrealized_gl ug
        ON hr.house_hold_name = ug.house_hold_name

),
household_risk_level AS (

    SELECT

        hr.house_hold_name,

        CASE

            WHEN hr.drift_risk > 4
                 OR hr.concentration_risk > 25
                 OR hr.cash_risk > 15
            THEN 'high'

            WHEN hr.drift_risk > 2
                 OR hr.cash_risk > 10
            THEN 'medium'

            ELSE 'low'

        END AS risk_level

    FROM household_risk hr

)

beginning_household_aum AS (

    JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.household_details h

    GROUP BY

/* Household NNM YTD */
household_nna_ytd AS (

                    ('CONTRIBUTION','TRANSFER_IN','RFF','CSR')

            END
        ) AS nna_ytd
    FROM wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.transactions t

          AND l.max_snapshot_date
          AND fa.account_status_indicator = 'O'
          AND fa.is_active = 1
    GROUP BY

),

/* Current Equity % at Account Level */
account_equity AS (
    SELECT
        ac.account_number,
        ac.financial_account_id,
        ac.total_equity AS equity_value,

        (
            COALESCE(p.amount,0)
            +
            COALESCE(ac.cash_available,0)

        CASE
            WHEN (
                COALESCE(p.amount,0)
                +
                COALESCE(ac.cash_available,0)
            ) = 0
            THEN NULL

            ELSE ac.total_equity * 100.0
            /
            (
                COALESCE(p.amount,0)
                +
                COALESCE(ac.cash_available,0)
            )
        END AS current_equity_pct
    FROM wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.positions p
    JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.account_summary ac

    JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.financial_account a

    CROSS JOIN latest_snapshot l

      AND a.account_status_indicator = 'O'
      AND a.is_active = 1

/* Drift Per Account */
account_drift AS (
    SELECT
        h.house_hold_name,
        fa.investment_professional_number,
        ae.account_number,
        ae.current_equity_pct,
        dmp.target_equity_pct,
        (ae.current_equity_pct - dmp.target_equity_pct) AS drift_pct,
        ae.total_value
    FROM account_equity ae
    JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.financial_account fa

    JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.household_details h

    JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.silver.account_model_mapping amm

    JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.dim_model_portfolio dmp
        ON dmp.model_id = amm.model_id
),

/* Household Drift */
household_drift AS (
    SELECT
        house_hold_name,
        SUM(drift_pct * total_value) / NULLIF(SUM(total_value),0) AS model_drift
    FROM account_drift
    GROUP BY

),
household_unrealized_gl AS (

        hd.house_hold_name,

    CROSS JOIN latest_snapshot l

    WHERE p.snapshot_date = l.max_snapshot_date
      AND fa.account_status_indicator = 'O'
      AND fa.is_active = 1

    GROUP BY

),
household_market_value AS (

        SUM(p.amount) AS market_value

account_cash AS (

    FROM wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.account_summary a

    JOIN household_market_value mv
        ON a.financial_account_id = mv.financial_account_id

        ON a.financial_account_id = hd.financial_account_id

    JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.financial_account fa
        ON a.financial_account_id = fa.financial_account_id

    WHERE fa.account_status_indicator='O'
      AND fa.is_active=1

),
household_cash_drag AS (

    SELECT

        house_hold_name,

        ROUND(

            (

                AVG(cash_pct) - 0.03

            )

            *

            (

                10 --10
                -
                4.5 --4.5

            )

            *10000,

            2

        ) AS cash_drag_bps

    FROM account_cash

    WHERE cash_pct > 0.03

    GROUP BY
        house_hold_name

),
household_advisors AS (

SELECT

    hd.house_hold_name,

    STRING_AGG(
        DISTINCT fa.rep_id,
        ', '
    ) AS advisor_ids

FROM wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.household_details hd

JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.financial_account acc
    ON hd.financial_account_id = acc.financial_account_id

JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.financial_advisor fa

WHERE acc.account_status_indicator='O'
  AND acc.is_active=1
  AND fa.is_active=1

GROUP BY
    hd.house_hold_name

),
client_segment AS (

    SELECT
        t.house_hold_name,

        CASE
            WHEN MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN t.entity_name IS NOT NULL
                         AND TRIM(t.entity_name) <> ''
                    THEN 1
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ) = 1
                THEN 'Corporate'

            WHEN SUM(t.maximum_net_worth) >= 10000000
                THEN 'UHNW'

            WHEN SUM(t.maximum_net_worth) >= 1000000
                THEN 'HNW'

            WHEN SUM(t.maximum_net_worth) IS NOT NULL
                THEN 'Mass Affluent'

            WHEN SUM(t.maximum_annual_income) >= 1000000
                THEN 'UHNW (Estimated)'

            WHEN SUM(t.maximum_annual_income) >= 250000
                THEN 'HNW (Estimated)'

            ELSE 'Mass Affluent'
        END AS household_segment

    FROM (

        SELECT DISTINCT

            hd.house_hold_name,
            pa.person_account_id,
            pa.entity_name,
            pa.maximum_net_worth,
            pa.maximum_annual_income

        FROM wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.positions p

        JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.household_details hd
            ON p.financial_account_id = hd.financial_account_id

        JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.person_financial_mapping pfm
            ON p.financial_account_id = pfm.financial_account_id

        JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.person_account pa
            ON pfm.person_account_id = pa.person_account_id

        JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.financial_account fa
            ON p.financial_account_id = fa.financial_account_id

        CROSS JOIN latest_snapshot l

        WHERE p.snapshot_date = l.max_snapshot_date
          AND fa.account_status_indicator = 'O'
          AND fa.is_active = 1

    ) t

    GROUP BY
        t.house_hold_name

),

/* Account level AUM and cash */
account_base AS (
    SELECT
        ac.financial_account_id,
        ac.account_number,
        h.house_hold_name,
        (
            COALESCE(p.amount,0)
            +
            COALESCE(ac.cash_available,0)
        ) AS account_aum,
        CASE
            WHEN (
                COALESCE(p.amount,0)
                +
                COALESCE(ac.cash_available,0)
            ) = 0
            THEN 0
            ELSE
                ac.cash_available * 100.0
                /
                (
                    COALESCE(p.amount,0)
                    +
                    COALESCE(ac.cash_available,0)
                )
        END AS cash_pct
        
    FROM wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.positions p
    JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.account_summary ac
        ON ac.financial_account_id = p.financial_account_id
    JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.household_details h
        ON ac.financial_account_id = h.financial_account_id
    JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.financial_account fa
    ON ac.financial_account_id = fa.financial_account_id
    CROSS JOIN latest_snapshot l
    WHERE p.snapshot_date = l.max_snapshot_date
        AND fa.account_status_indicator = 'O'
        AND fa.is_active = 1
),
/* Maximum security concentration per account */
account_concentration AS (
    SELECT
        p.financial_account_id,
        MAX(
            ABS(p.amount)
            *100.0
            /
            NULLIF(ab.account_aum,0)
        ) AS concentration_pct
    FROM wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.positions p
    JOIN account_base ab
        ON p.financial_account_id = ab.financial_account_id
    JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.financial_account fa
        ON p.financial_account_id = fa.financial_account_id
    CROSS JOIN latest_snapshot l
    WHERE p.snapshot_date = l.max_snapshot_date
          AND fa.account_status_indicator = 'O'
          AND fa.is_active = 1
    GROUP BY
        p.financial_account_id
),
/* Account model drift */
account_drift1 AS (
    SELECT
        ab.financial_account_id,
        ABS(

            (
                ac.total_equity * 100.0
                /
                NULLIF(
                    (
                        COALESCE(p.amount,0)
                        +
                        COALESCE(ac.cash_available,0)
                    ),
                    0
                )

            )
            -
            dmp.target_equity_pct
        ) AS drift_pct
    FROM wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.positions p
    JOIN account_base ab
        ON p.financial_account_id = ab.financial_account_id
    JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.account_summary ac
        ON ab.financial_account_id =
           ac.financial_account_id
    JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.silver.account_model_mapping amm
        ON ab.account_number =
           amm.account_number
    JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.dim_model_portfolio dmp
        ON amm.model_id =
           dmp.model_id
    CROSS JOIN latest_snapshot l
    WHERE p.snapshot_date = l.max_snapshot_date
),


/* Household weighted risk metrics */
household_risk AS (
    SELECT
        ab.house_hold_name,
        /* Maximum concentration risk */
        MAX(
            COALESCE(cc.concentration_pct,0)
        ) AS concentration_risk,


        /* AUM weighted drift */
        SUM(
            COALESCE(ad.drift_pct,0)
            *
            ab.account_aum
        )
        /
        NULLIF(
            SUM(ab.account_aum),
            0
        ) AS drift_risk,


        /* AUM weighted cash */
        SUM(
            ab.cash_pct
            *
            ab.account_aum
        )
        /
        NULLIF(
            SUM(ab.account_aum),
            0
        ) AS cash_risk
    FROM account_base ab
    LEFT JOIN account_concentration cc
        ON ab.financial_account_id =
           cc.financial_account_id
    LEFT JOIN account_drift1 ad
        ON ab.financial_account_id =
           ad.financial_account_id
    GROUP BY
        ab.house_hold_name
),
/* Calculate household risk score */
household_score AS (
    SELECT
        house_hold_name,
        (
            (CASE
                WHEN concentration_risk > 10
                THEN 100
                ELSE concentration_risk * 10
             END)

            +

            (CASE
                WHEN drift_risk > 8
                THEN 100
                ELSE drift_risk * 12.5
             END)

            +

            (CASE
                WHEN cash_risk > 10
                THEN 100
                ELSE cash_risk * 10
             END)

        ) / 3 AS risk_score
    FROM household_risk
),
household_alerts AS (

    SELECT

        hr.house_hold_name,

        CASE

            /* Critical */

            WHEN hr.concentration_risk > 10
                 OR hr.drift_risk > 8
            THEN CONCAT(
                    'CRITICAL - ',
                    CONCAT_WS(', ',
                        CASE
                            WHEN hr.concentration_risk > 10
                            THEN 'Concentration > 10%'
                        END,
                        CASE
                            WHEN hr.drift_risk > 8
                            THEN 'Model Drift > 8%'
                        END
                    )
                 )

            /* Warning */

            WHEN hr.drift_risk > 4
                 OR hr.cash_risk > 10
            THEN CONCAT(
                    'WARNING - ',
                    CONCAT_WS(', ',
                        CASE
                            WHEN hr.drift_risk > 4
                            THEN 'Model Drift > 4%'
                        END,
                        CASE
                            WHEN hr.cash_risk > 10
                            THEN 'Cash > 10%'
                        END
                    )
                 )

            /* Opportunity */

            WHEN ug.unrealized_gl < -5000
            THEN 'OPPORTUNITY - Tax Loss Harvesting'

            ELSE 'NO ALERT'

        END AS risk_alert,

        CASE

            WHEN hr.concentration_risk > 10
                 OR hr.drift_risk > 8
            THEN 'CRITICAL'

            WHEN hr.drift_risk > 4
                 OR hr.cash_risk > 10
            THEN 'WARNING'

            WHEN ug.unrealized_gl < -5000
            THEN 'OPPORTUNITY'

            ELSE 'NONE'

        END AS alert_severity

    FROM household_risk hr

    LEFT JOIN household_unrealized_gl ug
        ON hr.house_hold_name = ug.house_hold_name

),
household_risk_level AS (

    SELECT

        hr.house_hold_name,

        CASE

            WHEN hr.drift_risk > 4
                 OR hr.concentration_risk > 25
                 OR hr.cash_risk > 15
            THEN 'high'

            WHEN hr.drift_risk > 2
                 OR hr.cash_risk > 10
            THEN 'medium'

            ELSE 'low'

        END AS risk_level

    FROM household_risk hr

)


SELECT
    ha.house_hold_name AS household,
    cs.household_segment,
    adv.advisor_ids,
    ha.aum,
    ((ha.aum - COALESCE(b.beginning_aum,0)) / NULLIF(b.beginning_aum,0)) * 100 AS ytd_return,

/* Account level AUM and cash allocation */
account_metrics_base AS (
    SELECT
        ac.financial_account_id,
        (
            COALESCE(ac.trade_date_net_worth,0)
            +
            COALESCE(ac.cash_available,0)
        ) AS account_aum,
        CASE
            WHEN (
                COALESCE(ac.trade_date_net_worth,0)
                +
                COALESCE(ac.cash_available,0)
            ) = 0
            THEN 0
            ELSE
                ac.cash_available * 100.0
                /
                (
                    COALESCE(ac.trade_date_net_worth,0)
                    +
                    COALESCE(ac.cash_available,0)
                )
        END AS cash_pct
    FROM wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.account_summary ac
),

/* Security concentration per account */
security_concentration AS (
    SELECT
        p.financial_account_id,
        MAX(
            ABS(p.amount) * 100.0
            /
            NULLIF(am.account_aum,0)
        ) AS max_position_pct
    FROM wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.positions p
    JOIN account_metrics_base am
        ON p.financial_account_id = am.financial_account_id
    CROSS JOIN latest_snapshot l
    WHERE p.snapshot_date = l.max_snapshot_date
    GROUP BY
        p.financial_account_id
),

/* Unrealized gain/loss */
account_pnl AS (
    SELECT
        financial_account_id,

        SUM(
            amount - total_cost
        ) AS unrealized_gl

    FROM wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.positions

    CROSS JOIN latest_snapshot l

    WHERE snapshot_date = l.max_snapshot_date

    GROUP BY
        financial_account_id
),


/* Model drift calculation */
account_drift AS (
    SELECT
        ac.financial_account_id,

        ABS(
            (
                ac.total_equity * 100.0
                /
                NULLIF(
                    (
                        COALESCE(ac.trade_date_net_worth,0)
                        +
                        COALESCE(ac.cash_available,0)
                    ),
                    0
                )
            )
            -
            dmp.target_equity_pct
        ) AS drift_pct

    FROM wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.account_summary ac

    JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.financial_account fa
        ON ac.financial_account_id = fa.financial_account_id

    JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.silver.account_model_mapping amm
        ON amm.account_number = fa.account_number

    JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.dim_model_portfolio dmp
        ON dmp.model_id = amm.model_id
),


/* Combine all account-level metrics */
account_alert_metrics AS (

    SELECT
        fa.investment_professional_number,

        sc.max_position_pct,

        d.drift_pct,

        am.cash_pct,

        pnl.unrealized_gl

    FROM account_metrics_base am

    JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.financial_account fa
        ON am.financial_account_id = fa.financial_account_id

    LEFT JOIN security_concentration sc
        ON am.financial_account_id = sc.financial_account_id

    LEFT JOIN account_drift d
        ON am.financial_account_id = d.financial_account_id

    LEFT JOIN account_pnl pnl
        ON am.financial_account_id = pnl.financial_account_id
)

    investment_professional_number AS advisor,


    /* CRITICAL ALERTS */
    COUNT(
        CASE
            WHEN max_position_pct > 10
              OR drift_pct > 8
            THEN 1
        END
    ) AS critical_alerts,


    /* WARNING ALERTS */
    COUNT(
        CASE
            WHEN drift_pct > 4
              OR cash_pct > 10
            THEN 1
        END
    ) AS warning_alerts,


    /* OPPORTUNITY ALERTS */
    COUNT(
        CASE
            WHEN unrealized_gl < -5000
            THEN 1
        END
    ) AS opportunity_alerts


FROM account_alert_metrics

        FROM wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.positions p

        JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.household_details hd
            ON p.financial_account_id = hd.financial_account_id

        JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.person_financial_mapping pfm
            ON p.financial_account_id = pfm.financial_account_id

        JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.person_account pa
            ON pfm.person_account_id = pa.person_account_id

        WHERE p.snapshot_date = (
            SELECT snapshot_date
            FROM latest_snapshot
        )

    ) t

    GROUP BY
        t.house_hold_name

),
 
beginning_household_aum AS (
 
    SELECT
        hd.house_hold_name,
        SUM(p.amount) AS beginning_aum
    FROM wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.positions p
    JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.household_details hd
        ON p.financial_account_id = hd.financial_account_id
    JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.financial_account fa
        ON fa.financial_account_id = p.financial_account_id
    WHERE p.snapshot_date = (
        SELECT snapshot_date
        FROM beginning_snapshot
    )
        AND fa.account_status_indicator = 'O'
        AND fa.is_active = 1
    GROUP BY hd.house_hold_name
),
 
current_household_aum AS (
 
    SELECT
        hd.house_hold_name,
        SUM(p.amount) AS current_aum
 
    FROM wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.positions p
 
    JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.household_details hd
        ON p.financial_account_id = hd.financial_account_id
    JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.financial_account fa
        ON fa.financial_account_id = p.financial_account_id
    WHERE p.snapshot_date = (
        SELECT snapshot_date
        FROM latest_snapshot
    )
        AND fa.account_status_indicator = 'O'
        AND fa.is_active = 1
    GROUP BY hd.house_hold_name
 
),
 
ytd_cte AS (
 
    SELECT
        c.house_hold_name,
        c.current_aum,
        b.beginning_aum,
 
        ROUND(
            (
                c.current_aum - b.beginning_aum
            ) * 100.0
            / NULLIF(b.beginning_aum,0),
            2
        ) AS ytd
 
    FROM current_household_aum c
 
    JOIN beginning_household_aum b
        ON c.house_hold_name = b.house_hold_name
 
),
household_cash AS (

    SELECT
        hd.house_hold_name,
        SUM(ac.cash_available) AS cash_available,
        COUNT(DISTINCT hd.account_number) AS accounts,
        MIN(fa.date_account_opened) AS since,
        STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.custodian, ', ') AS custodians,
        CASE
            WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN fa.account_status_indicator <> 'O' THEN 1 END)=0
            THEN 'Open'
            ELSE 'Mixed'
        END AS status
    FROM wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.positions p

    JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.household_details hd
        ON p.financial_account_id = hd.financial_account_id

    LEFT JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.account_summary ac
        ON p.financial_account_id = ac.financial_account_id

    JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.financial_account fa
        ON p.financial_account_id = fa.financial_account_id

    WHERE p.snapshot_date = (
        SELECT snapshot_date
        FROM latest_snapshot
    )
    GROUP BY
        hd.house_hold_name

)

WITH latest_snapshot AS (
    SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) AS max_snapshot_date
    FROM wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.positions
),

position_mv AS (
    SELECT
        p.financial_account_id,
        SUM(p.amount) AS market_value
    FROM wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.positions p
    JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.financial_account a
        ON p.financial_account_id = a.financial_account_id
    CROSS JOIN latest_snapshot l
    WHERE p.snapshot_date = l.max_snapshot_date
      AND a.account_status_indicator = 'O'
      AND a.is_active = 1
    GROUP BY
        p.financial_account_id
),

account_cash AS (
    SELECT
        hd.house_hold_name,
        a.financial_account_id,
        mv.market_value,
        a.cash_available,
        a.cash_available / NULLIF(mv.market_value,0) AS cash_pct
    FROM wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.account_summary a
    JOIN position_mv mv
        ON a.financial_account_id = mv.financial_account_id
    LEFT JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.household_details hd
        ON a.financial_account_id = hd.financial_account_id
    JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.financial_account fa
        ON a.financial_account_id = fa.financial_account_id
    WHERE fa.account_status_indicator = 'O'
      AND fa.is_active = 1
),
household_aum AS (

    SELECT

        hd.house_hold_name,

        SUM(p.amount) AS household_aum

    FROM wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.positions p

    JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.household_details hd
        ON p.financial_account_id = hd.financial_account_id

    JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.financial_account fa
        ON p.financial_account_id = fa.financial_account_id

    CROSS JOIN latest_snapshot l

    WHERE p.snapshot_date = l.max_snapshot_date
      AND fa.account_status_indicator = 'O'
      AND fa.is_active = 1

    GROUP BY
        hd.house_hold_name

),
/* Idle cash only for households exceeding 5% */
household_idle_cash AS (

    SELECT
        house_hold_name,
        ROUND(SUM(cash_available),2) AS idle_cash
    FROM account_cash
    GROUP BY
        house_hold_name

),

/* Complete household list */
households AS (

    SELECT DISTINCT
        house_hold_name
    FROM wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.household_details

)

SELECT

    h.house_hold_name,

    ROUND(COALESCE(ha.household_aum,0),2) AS aum,

    ROUND(COALESCE(hic.idle_cash,0),2) AS cash,

    ROUND(
        COALESCE(hic.idle_cash,0)
        * 100.0
        /
        NULLIF(ha.household_aum,0),
        2
    ) AS cash_pct_aum

FROM households h

LEFT JOIN household_idle_cash hic
    ON h.house_hold_name = hic.house_hold_name

LEFT JOIN household_aum ha
    ON h.house_hold_name = ha.house_hold_name

ORDER BY
    cash DESC,
    h.house_hold_name;

WITH latest_snapshot AS (

    SELECT
        MAX(snapshot_date) AS snapshot_date
    FROM wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.positions

),

client_segment AS (

    SELECT
        t.house_hold_name,

        CASE
            WHEN MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN t.entity_name IS NOT NULL
                         AND TRIM(t.entity_name) <> ''
                    THEN 1
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ) = 1
                THEN 'Corporate'

            WHEN SUM(t.maximum_net_worth) >= 10000000
                THEN 'UHNW'

            WHEN SUM(t.maximum_net_worth) >= 1000000
                THEN 'HNW'

            WHEN SUM(t.maximum_net_worth) IS NOT NULL
                THEN 'Mass Affluent'

            WHEN SUM(t.maximum_annual_income) >= 1000000
                THEN 'UHNW (Estimated)'

            WHEN SUM(t.maximum_annual_income) >= 250000
                THEN 'HNW (Estimated)'

            ELSE 'Mass Affluent'
        END AS client_segment

    FROM (

        SELECT DISTINCT

            hd.house_hold_name,
            pa.person_account_id,
            pa.entity_name,
            pa.maximum_net_worth,
            pa.maximum_annual_income

        FROM wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.positions p

        JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.household_details hd
            ON p.financial_account_id = hd.financial_account_id

        JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.person_financial_mapping pfm
            ON p.financial_account_id = pfm.financial_account_id

        JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.person_account pa
            ON pfm.person_account_id = pa.person_account_id

        JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.financial_account fa
            ON p.financial_account_id = fa.financial_account_id

        WHERE p.snapshot_date = (
                SELECT snapshot_date
                FROM latest_snapshot
              )
          AND fa.account_status_indicator = 'O'
          AND fa.is_active = 1

    ) t

    GROUP BY
        t.house_hold_name

),

household_aum AS (

    SELECT

        hd.house_hold_name,

        SUM(p.amount) AS household_aum

    FROM wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.positions p

    JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.household_details hd
        ON p.financial_account_id = hd.financial_account_id

    JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.financial_account fa
        ON p.financial_account_id = fa.financial_account_id

    WHERE p.snapshot_date = (
            SELECT snapshot_date
            FROM latest_snapshot
          )
      AND fa.account_status_indicator = 'O'
      AND fa.is_active = 1

    GROUP BY
        hd.house_hold_name

)

SELECT

    cs.client_segment,

    COUNT(DISTINCT ha.house_hold_name) AS household_count,

    ROUND(SUM(ha.household_aum),2) AS aum,

    ROUND(
        SUM(ha.household_aum) * 100.0 /
        SUM(SUM(ha.household_aum)) OVER (),
        2
    ) AS segment_aum_pct

FROM household_aum ha

JOIN client_segment cs
    ON ha.house_hold_name = cs.house_hold_name

GROUP BY
    cs.client_segment

ORDER BY
    aum DESC;

WITH latest_snapshot AS (

    SELECT
        MAX(snapshot_date) AS end_date
    FROM wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.positions

),

beginning_snapshot AS (

    SELECT
        MAX(snapshot_date) AS start_date
    FROM wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.positions
    WHERE snapshot_date < (
        SELECT DATE_TRUNC('year', end_date)
        FROM latest_snapshot
    )

)

SELECT

    t.investment_professional_number,

    ROUND(

        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN t.transaction_code IN
                    ('CONTRIBUTION','TRANSFER_IN','RFF','CSR')
                THEN ABS(t.amount)
                ELSE 0
            END
        )
        -
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN t.transaction_code IN
                    ('DISTRIBUTION','TRANSFER_OUT','SFF','PCC')
                THEN ABS(t.amount)
                ELSE 0
            END
        ),

        2

    ) AS net_new_assets

FROM wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.transactions t

JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.gold.financial_account fa
    ON t.financial_account_id = fa.financial_account_id

CROSS JOIN latest_snapshot ls
CROSS JOIN beginning_snapshot bs

WHERE CAST(t.transaction_date AS DATE)
      BETWEEN bs.start_date
          AND ls.end_date

  AND fa.account_status_indicator = 'O'
  AND fa.is_active = 1

GROUP BY
    t.investment_professional_number

ORDER BY
    net_new_assets DESC

LIMIT 10;
